heating_cooling: Heat is the main threat. Plan shade, airflow and water; rest midday; know cooling centers; watch for heat illness.

risks: Floods contaminate wells and springs; disinfect and test after flooding.
Arsenic: USGS estimates roughly 35,000 people here use private wells likely above EPA's arsenic limit (2017 model estimate). Boiling does NOT remove arsenic; test private wells.
